ogTitle: Title and Caption Preview - Before You Publish
ogDescription: Preview YouTube search results and Instagram caption truncation with your own text, side by side.
ldDescription: Preview how a title and description appear in YouTube search and where an Instagram caption truncates behind More, using your own text.
lede: Type a title, channel and caption to see the same text as a YouTube search card and an Instagram post - including exactly where it gets cut off.

faq.q: How does YouTube cut off a title?
faq.a: The search card shows about two lines, which is often 60-70 characters, depending on the letters and the screen. The preview clamps at two lines so you see the real cut.

faq.q: Where does Instagram hide the caption?
faq.a: The feed shows roughly the first two lines before More. The first line should carry the hook, because everything after the cut is hidden.
